export const FALLBACK_TRAINER_COURSES = [
  ["frontend-react-development", "React Frontend Development", "Components, hooks, state management, and frontend projects", "Frontend Development"],
  ["frontend-nextjs-development", "Next.js Production Development", "Routing, server rendering, API routes, auth, and deployment", "Frontend Development"],
  ["html-css-responsive-design", "HTML CSS Responsive Web Design", "Layouts, responsive UI, forms, animations, and landing pages", "Web Development"],
  ["full-stack-web-development", "Full Stack Web Development", "Frontend, backend, APIs, database, and deployment", "Full Stack Development"],
  ["mern-stack-development", "MERN Stack Development", "MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js, JWT auth, and projects", "Full Stack Development"],
  ["javascript-development", "Modern JavaScript Development", "ES6, async programming, DOM, APIs, and projects", "Web Development"],
  ["node-api-development", "Node.js Backend API Development", "Express APIs, authentication, validation, and database integration", "Backend Development"],
  ["spring-boot-api-development", "Spring Boot API Development", "REST APIs, security, services, repositories, and database access", "Backend Development"],
  ["python-programming", "Python Programming", "Core Python, problem solving, automation, and practical tasks", "Programming"],
  ["java-programming", "Java Programming", "OOP, collections, exception handling, and application development", "Programming"],
  ["flutter-mobile-development", "Flutter Mobile App Development", "Widgets, navigation, API integration, Firebase, and app release", "Mobile App Development"],
  ["react-native-development", "React Native App Development", "Mobile UI, navigation, native APIs, and cross-platform apps", "Mobile App Development"],
  ["sql-database-development", "SQL Database Development", "Queries, joins, schema design, and database practice", "Database"],
  ["mongodb-nosql-development", "MongoDB NoSQL Development", "Collections, schemas, aggregation, indexing, and app integration", "Database"],
  ["devops-cloud-deployment", "DevOps and Cloud Deployment", "Git, CI/CD, VPS deployment, Nginx, and cloud basics", "DevOps"],
  ["aws-cloud-development", "AWS Cloud Development", "Cloud basics, hosting, storage, deployment, and production setup", "Cloud Computing"],
  ["ui-ux-product-design", "UI UX Product Design", "Wireframes, user flows, design systems, and Figma practice", "UI/UX Design"],
].map(([id, title, subtitle, category]) => ({
  id,
  isFallback: true,
  title,
  subtitle,
  category,
}));
